messages:
Leah Morgan: Kicking off Azimuth Health onboarding here. Key goals: PHI-safe ingest into private staging, SSO (SAML) for their admin group, baseline perf for clinician queries, and two enablement sessions for ops/admins. Looking for owners and any immediate blockers.

Tomás Rivera: I can lead data pipeline + PHI controls. Need to confirm whether they want field-level de-id before upload or on-platform masking. Also need dataset size estimate (rows + avg text length).

Ivy Zhang: I'll take SSO + compliance checklist. Immediate asks: SAML metadata, test IdP, and note on audit-log retention (they requested 1 year).

Nora Patel: I'll handle enablement + renewal health tracking. Proposed success criteria to link to renewal: 1) 2 admin users fully onboarded and able to configure app, 2) ingestion of at least 5k de-identified records into staging, 3) perf p95 <300ms for triage prompts, 4) audit logs streaming to customer SIEM.

Leah Morgan: Tentative timeline:
Week 0: discovery call + SAML exchange + data export sample
Week 1: private staging deploy + ingest dry run + basic smoke tests
Week 2: compliance review + enablement sessions (recorded)
Week 3: joint runbook + go/no-go + production cutover

Tomás Rivera: Data upload example I'll ask them to run (SFTP preferred):
```
sftp user@azimuth-sftp.acme.com:/uploads<< 'EOF'
put azimuth_sample.csv
EOF
```

Ivy Zhang: For SAML exchange please have them send: IdP metadata XML, test account (email pattern), and attribute mappings (email, name, org). If metadata delayed >4 business days mark renewal-risk.

infra-bot: private-deploy scheduled: azimuth-staging v1.7 -> Tue 04:00 UTC. Notify #eng-infra on failures.

Nora Patel: Small ask: we'll gather two use-case prompts to include in the perf suite. Leah, can you get a short list from their PM by EOD tomorrow?

Leah Morgan: Yep will ping PM. Also pinging Legal for data processing agreement sign-off.

Tomás Rivera: On masking: prefer pre-ingest de-id. If they can't, we can onboard with platform masking but will require extra review and a temporary waiver.

Ivy Zhang: Noted. I'll draft the compliance checklist and set a Tuesday review slot.

Nora Patel: I'll draft enablement invite + short admin playbook (one-pager) and share draft by Wed.

Leah Morgan: Owners recap: TomE1s (ingest/PHI), Ivy (SSO/compliance), Nora (enablement + renewals). Please update this thread with any blockers. Next sync Thu 11am PT to confirm SAML and ingestion status. :calendar:
